 사진 확대 IVE. Photo: Starship Entertainment The group IVE proved its global influence with its new song ‘Looks Can Kill.’
 According to its agency, Starship Entertainment, on the 20th, the music video for ‘Looks Can Kill,’ the title track IVE pre-released the previous day, rose to No. 1 on YouTube’s Music Videos Trending Worldwide chart immediately after its release.
 It also topped the charts in six countries and regions, including South Korea, Japan, the UK, France, Canada and Brazil, and entered the top 10 in a total of 18 countries and regions, including the US, Germany and Australia.
 ‘Looks Can Kill’ is an electronic dance-pop song that captures IVE’s signature confidence and sense of initiative. Its lyrics carry the message that anyone can be the protagonist and a hero in their own life.
 The music video creates a stylish visual aesthetic with scenes moving between on and off the set and dazzling visual effects. In particular, it clearly conveys the album’s concept by expanding the idea from ‘IVE playing heroes’ to ‘IVE as heroes in their own right.’
 After first performing ‘Looks Can Kill’ at the ‘Spotify DIVE ACADEMY’ live stage held at ARC GANGNAM in Seoul on the 19th, IVE will make its official comeback on the 26th with a mini-album of the same name.
 [Lee Da-gyeom, Star Today reporter]
